items.note: The first read now subscribes inside its `try`, so a throwing `subscribe` counts as a failed read. `localStorageAdapter.subscribe` no longer throws where the browser blocks site data, which also stops `createRecordCache` from throwing there.

items.claim: Heard delete of a record the cache lacks doesn't void an in-flight read-back

items.note: When the window regains focus, it waits 500 ms, then resolves with the chosen file or `null` and removes its input.
duplicate of A's finding, fixed ba01f7942a

items.claim: Read-back compares structured-clone values by identity
items.note: The new `cloneEqual` compares a `Map`, `Set`, `Date`, `RegExp`, buffer or typed array by content, and works across realms. I removed the matching "Open:" note from `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A reconcile read that throws drops the contested record
items.note: A failed read-back keeps the record contested and reads it again on the cache's `retryMs` backoff. With `retryMs: false` it waits for the next write of ours to land.
`docs/unruled.md` records it as "Left as is: it may be the intended retry path".

items.claim: `isJsonSafe` calls an object with symbol keys safe
Percent-encoded fragment reads as empty, and the next write wipes it
`isJsonSafe` called an object with a non-enumerable own key safe, though JSON drops that key too
items.note: in the same commit as the symbol-key fix.
